fields.body_md:
## About this programme

Looking at a data science master's at Nottingham? Here is what it costs, who can get in and the 2027 dates.

The Data Science MSc is a **12-month**, full-time course starting September 2027. Part-time study is not available. The School of Computer Science is on Jubilee Campus.

You take **180 credits**: 120 credits of modules plus a **60-credit** individual project. Your module mix depends on your first degree. For example, computer science graduates take between 40 and 80 credits from a list of Computer Science modules. You need at least **50%** to pass a module.

For the wider university, see our [University of Nottingham page](/study-abroad/universities/university-of-nottingham).

## Can you get in?

**Degree.** You need a 2:1, or international equivalent, with an affinity for programming and/or advanced statistics, shown through study or work. Graduates of other fields with a strong maths or computer science background are considered with a **60%** average mark. A 2:1 is a UK honours grade.

**Indian marks.** Nottingham's India page sorts Indian universities into three tiers. For a 2:1 you need **60%** (CGPA 6.0/10) from a Tier 1 university, **65%** (6.5/10) from Tier 2, or **70%** (7.0/10) from Tier 3. Check your university on Nottingham's India University tier list.

**GRE.** The course page does not mention GRE. GRE is a US-style graduate admissions test.

**English.** IELTS is an English language test. This course asks for **IELTS 6.5** with at least **6.0** in each element. Nottingham also accepts other tests, including TOEFL iBT and Pearson PTE. If you complete a presessional English course to the required level, you do not need to retake IELTS.

**ATAS.** ATAS (Academic Technology Approval Scheme) is a UK security clearance that some science and technology courses need before you get a visa. Nottingham's course page does not say whether this course needs it. Ask the admissions team when you get your offer. If it is needed, an ATAS application takes at least **30 working days**.

## What it costs

Tuition for international students is **£34,800** for full-time study starting September 2027.

Nottingham is outside London, so the outside-London visa rule applies. This is the worked first-year total.

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Tuition for international students, September 2027 | £34,800 |
| Living money you must show for your visa: £1,171 × 9 months | £10,539 |
| Student visa application fee, from outside the UK | £558 |
| Immigration Health Surcharge for a visa of just over a year | £1,164 |
| **Total** | **£47,061** |

The sum is £34,800 + £10,539 + £558 + £1,164 = £47,061. Travel and housing are not included.

**Living money is money you show, not a fee.** The visa rule is **£1,171** for each month of your course outside London, up to **9 months**. You must hold this money for **28 days** in a row. The 28-day period must end within **31 days** of the date you apply. You do not pay it to the university.

**Health surcharge.** The Immigration Health Surcharge (IHS) is a charge for using the NHS while you are in the UK. It is set by the length of your visa, not your course. For a course of 12 months or longer, the visa adds up to **1 month** before and **4 months** after the course. That makes a visa of more than a year but under 18 months. You then pay the yearly **£776** plus half of it, **£388**, so **£1,164**.

**Deposit.** International students starting a full-time taught course pay a CAS deposit of **£4,500** as part of the visa process. A CAS (Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies) is the electronic letter your visa application needs. It is waived only if a recognised sponsor fully funds you.

**Application fee.** Nottingham's apply page says you pay a fee only if one is required. No amount is shown for this course.

For the visa steps, read the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide). To plan the whole budget, use the [UK total cost breakdown](/study-abroad/study-in/uk/uk-total-cost-breakdown).

## Funding

- **International Postgraduate Scholarship:** **£3,000** off tuition for international students starting a full-time taught master's in 2027. It is automatic: no application is needed. You must be self-funded and not hold another University award or external sponsorship.

## Deadlines and intakes

| Intake | Who applies | Deadline | Where to apply |
|---|---|---|---|
| September 2027 | International applicants | NOT CONFIRMED (to be confirmed for 2027/28) | Nottingham online application |

Nottingham has not yet published its 2027/28 deadline. Apply early to leave time for the CAS deposit and the visa. The course page shows a September start only.

## How to apply

1. **Check the entry rule** and your university's tier on the India tier list.
2. **Apply online.** Start from the [course page](https://www.nottingham.ac.uk/pgstudy/course/taught/data-science-msc).
3. **Prepare your documents.** Have your degree certificate and transcripts and your English test result ready.
4. **Accept your offer and pay the CAS deposit** of **£4,500**. The university then issues your CAS.
5. **Check ATAS.** Ask the admissions team if the course needs an ATAS certificate.
6. **Apply for your visa.** You need your CAS, a current passport, proof of funds and your tuberculosis (TB) test result. India is on the UK's TB test list. The test must be at a clinic approved by the Home Office. Read the [TB test page](https://www.gov.uk/tb-test-visa/countries-where-you-need-a-tb-test-to-enter-the-uk) and the [UK student visa guide](/study-abroad/visas/uk-student-visa-guide).

## After the programme

- **Work in the UK after your course.** The Graduate Route lets you stay and work in the UK after your studies. The visa lasts **2 years** if you apply on or before **31 December 2026**, and **18 months** if you apply on or after **1 January 2027**. A September 2027 student applies in 2028, so expect 18 months. The application fee is **£937**.
- **Careers.** Nottingham says **93%** of postgraduates from its School of Computer Science were in graduate-level work or further study within 15 months. The average starting salary was **£34,189**.

## Who it suits

**This programme is a strong choice if:**

- you have programming or statistics in your degree or work
- you have 60% to 70% depending on your university's tier
- you want an automatic **£3,000** scholarship

**Think carefully if:**

- you have no programming or statistics background
- you need a January start, because only September is listed

faq_json.q: Can I do the Nottingham MSc Data Science without a computing degree?
faq_json.a: Possibly. You need a 2:1 with an affinity for programming or advanced statistics. Graduates of other fields with strong maths or computer science are considered with a 60% average.

faq_json.q: How much does it cost for Indian students?
faq_json.a: Tuition is £34,800 for September 2027. Adding visa living money, the visa fee and the health surcharge gives £47,061 for the year.

faq_json.q: What percentage do Indian students need?
faq_json.a: For a 2:1, Nottingham's India page lists 60%, 65% or 70% depending on your university's tier.

faq_json.q: Is there a scholarship for Indian students?
faq_json.a: The International Postgraduate Scholarship gives £3,000 off tuition automatically to self-funded international students starting in 2027.

faq_json.q: What IELTS score do I need?
faq_json.a: IELTS 6.5 with at least 6.0 in each element. The course page does not mention GRE.
